limitations: Connected pixel components are not expert motif parts; large connected designs can be discarded by existing component-size limits.
Small object-group holdouts do not establish unseen-artist, regional or motif-family generalisation.
No semantic family classifier, image segmentation fine-tune, crossing-order reconstruction, cultural inference or stitch model was trained.
Raw descriptor distances are diagnostic, not aesthetic quality or machine feasibility.
